title: Lots of Zombies! Tonbi's Tall Sprite Zombie edits.

posts.author: Gremus
posts.body:
So I needed more than one zombie and I like Tonbi's Tall Sprites. I changed some of the clothing, some are flipped, and a few have shifted arms and legs by 1 pixel so they "shamble" a bit more as they walk so they look more like a horde. Tried changing the skin tone and hair but it looked wrong.
The skull and teeth are from the Skeleton King from the same sprite sheet. The first one is "as is", the other 7 are variants.
Credit to Tonbi. Youll need to have MZ to use them.
